interpretation_limits.capture_efficiency: eta(E) is an effective recovery operator; ethanol in wine proxies unmeasured vapor and condensate composition.
interpretation_limits.line_reservoir: tau is physical line holdup only if compatible with an independent residence-time experiment; otherwise it is phenomenological.
interpretation_limits.weighting: Domain-mean sigma aligns calibration with NRMSE but is not an experimentally estimated analytical error model.
interpretation_limits.repeatability: Matched nominal replicates have condensate NRMSE about 1.06 for ethyl octanoate and 0.97 for isoamyl acetate.
interpretation_limits.post_hoc_status: Final exploratory nested test after correcting the capture scale and decision weighting; prospective confirmation is mandatory.
interpretation_limits.external_validation: All six runs informed development; leave-one-run-out is retrospective internal validation.

literature_basis.gas_liquid_partition: Morakul et al. 2011, DOI 10.1016/j.procbio.2011.01.034; Mouret et al. 2014, DOI 10.1016/j.foodres.2014.02.044
